stories.title: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow at $70 to $78 a share
stories.summary: Anthropic is offering 825 million Class A shares on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, expecting to raise roughly $57.75 billion to $64.35 billion, with trading expected to start November 19.
stories.why: The biggest AI-lab listing so far sets the public price on companies like the ones he is applying to.

stories.title: Anthropic's own announcement of the roadshow
stories.summary: Anthropic says 801,351,354 shares come from the company and 23,648,646 from existing holders, with a 30-day option for underwriters to buy 123.75 million more.
stories.why: Primary source for the IPO terms.

stories.title: Musk says Grok 4.8 has finished pretraining
stories.summary: Musk posted that pretraining is done and reinforcement learning is running after xAI rewrote its stack in C and C++, with a small rollout to Grok Bot users expected later this week. xAI has not published a release date or model card, so this is reported, not confirmed.
stories.why: Grok is a big story for him; a new flagship would reach Grok Bot first.

stories.title: OpenAI opens Businesses in ChatGPT in beta
stories.summary: Verified companies can claim a profile, add product feeds and launch their own Business Agents, starting with eligible US e-commerce and online service businesses.
stories.why: Shows where agent products for businesses are heading, close to the automation work he targets.

stories.title: Mercor raises $750M at a $20B valuation
stories.summary: The AI agent evaluation company is taking the money to sell evaluation to enterprises.
stories.why: Evaluation and annotation companies are a steady source of remote contract work like micro1.

stories.title: Startup funding roundup: Nominal $240M, Path Robotics $300M, Lumbra $25M
stories.summary: Nominal raised a $240 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation, Path Robotics $300 million at $2.45 billion, and Lumbra $25 million for auditable AI agents.
stories.why: Shows where hiring money is going: AI agents, robotics and industrial software.

stories.title: Safaricom rolls out Fintech 2.0, a rebuilt M-Pesa platform
stories.summary: The new microservices platform lifts capacity from about 4,500 to 6,000 transactions per second, scalable to 10,000, with open APIs and AI-driven security.
stories.why: Open APIs on M-Pesa are relevant to his fintech integration work.
